//: LaTeX Workshop. This file is COMMITTED and shared, so the default recipe must work on every machine: it calls `pdflatex` from PATH, which is what both TeX Live (Linux) and MiKTeX (Windows) put there. The MiKTeX absolute-path recipe below is kept as a fallback for a Windows box where VS Code has not picked up the PATH yet -- it was the original default, and it is machine-specific, so it is no longer the one that runs by default.

latex-workshop.latex.tools.//: Windows / MiKTeX fallback. Only used by the second recipe.
latex-workshop.latex.tools.name: pdflatex-miktex

//recipes: Twice, because the reports carry a table of contents and cross-references: the first pass writes the .aux and .toc, the second resolves them.
//autoBuild: onSave applies to hand-edited .tex. Generated reports are written by dyno/src/archimedes/report.py and are built explicitly, so this does not fire on them.
//rootFile: The generated section files carry a `% !TEX root` magic comment pointing at their own driver. Without it, auto-detection scans the workspace for \documentclass and can bind a section to another unit's report -- there is one report root per gearbox under dyno/logs/, plus the mac_motors one.
//clean: clean.method defaults to 'command', which shells out to latexmk (not installed in this MiKTeX) and pops a package-install dialog mid-build. 'glob' makes clean.fileTypes below actually apply.
